description: Texts with a mark after an initial's period or after a parenthesis inside a quotation, recorded ahead of the text stage that will speak them: DECtalk sends one period for "J.?", a question mark for "Mary K.?", and a comma and an empty clause for a question mark or a comma after "(...)" inside a quotation. The sentences were listed with those of dectalk-us-empty-clause-v1 and moved here, unchanged, when the export showed the frontend does not yet give DECtalk's clauses for them.
